newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures cut gains, still higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures cut gains, still higher.

text.p: Oct 1 - U.S. stock index futures cut the biggest gains but stayed stronger. Traders said the earlier rise to peaks appeared driven by the cash market, where they noted good fund buying and cash-only buy programs that widened the futures premium enough for some index arb buy programs. They said locals covered shorts on the rise, which soon lost power. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
